description: Land Title Settlement Department - Digampathaha, Dambulla D/S Division, Matale District - Cad. Map No. 310019
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, and ownership details) in various villages. The content focuses on land ownership determinations, cadastral mapping, and title settlement processes, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
